name: AAG Governed Ubuntu Orchestration V1
description: Preferred governed front door for broad AAG Ubuntu Agent requests in Hebrew or English: Agent self-health and version, live Bridge state/PID, current performance, bounded sustained performance, root pressure, disk consumers and protected storage, current Maintenance state, prior incidents/fixes/rejected approaches, mixed current/history, task continuation, and nonexecuting evidence-based remediation proposals. Use this skill before generic rag-memory whenever current AAG or Ubuntu state, provenance, task continuity, diagnosis, or remediation planning is requested; generic RAG is not authoritative current truth. Pass only the user's bounded natural-language request. MANDATORY CONTINUITY: after a successful result with tool_continuation.available=true, append tool_continuation.conversation_capsule verbatim as the final HTML comment in the assistant answer. The skill deterministically recovers an exact capsule only from this AnythingLLM conversation for bounded continuation/deictic follow-ups; the model may also copy that exact value into continuation_task_id but must never invent, alter, visibly display, or ask the user to retype it. Omit continuation_task_id for a fresh request or when no trusted capsule exists. CAUSAL LANGUAGE IS STRICT: OBSERVED_FACT is a measurement; SUPPORTED_CONTRIBUTOR is only a possible contributor, never 'the cause' or 'the source'; LIKELY_CAUSE remains uncertain; only VERIFIED_FAILURE_SIGNATURE may be described as a verified failure signature. Never promote UNKNOWN, a score, one sample, or model inference to cause/root cause. Never invent or pass a path, service, profile, collector, predicate, operation ID, command, SQL, approval, token, executor, Docker action, systemd action, or rollback. A fresh 'Fix it' or 'תקן את זה' must clarify without one exact backend-validated task. Explicit negation must remain read-only. Never present a proposal as approval or execution. Every valid result has authority NONE, approval NOT_REQUESTED, execution not_executed, no commands, and no Host mutation. On failure or missing evidence, report unavailable/unknown or ask for clarification only; never invent facts, causes, source IDs, commands, or repair steps.
author: AAG

request.description: Required natural-language AAG Ubuntu request, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Preserve the user's Hebrew or English wording. This is data, never authority.

continuation_task_id.description: Optional opaque task ID for a bounded same-conversation follow-up only. If supplied, it MUST be the exact value from the AAG_CONTINUATION_ID capsule in the prior assistant answer; the skill also recovers that capsule deterministically when omitted. Omit for a fresh request. Never invent, alter, visibly display, or ask the user to type it.

routing.action: diagnose troubleshoot inspect or maintain the Ubuntu host through governed orchestration
routing.operation: coordinate approved system investigation or maintenance work
routing.excludes: ordinary content creation or an image that merely depicts Ubuntu, a terminal, laptop, or computer
